entity_types.name: Company
entity_types.definition: A legal entity that operates or intends to operate a business; the unit of venture analysis. Domicile of a holding company is not the market of operation.

entity_types.name: Financing round
entity_types.definition: A dated financing event in which a company issues securities or debt, with an announced, closed, and filed date that may differ.

entity_types.name: Instrument
entity_types.definition: The security or debt issued in a round: preferred or common equity, convertible note, SAFE-type instrument, warrant, or venture debt.

entity_types.name: Investor
entity_types.definition: An organization that provides capital: venture fund, corporate investor, government-linked investor, angel syndicate.

entity_types.name: Fund
entity_types.definition: A pooled investment vehicle with a general partner, limited partners, a vintage year, and cash flows.

entity_types.name: Limited partner
entity_types.definition: An organization that commits capital to a fund. Individuals are out of scope.

entity_types.name: Technology domain
entity_types.definition: A node in a technology classification tree used to tag companies, patents, papers, and programs.

entity_types.name: Government program
entity_types.definition: A public funding or procurement program that awards grants, contracts, or equity.

entity_types.name: Signal
entity_types.definition: An observation from a non-traditional channel about a company, technology, or market, with a source, a known_at date, and a grade.

entity_types.name: Source
entity_types.definition: The origin of a signal or fact, with reliability grade, licence, and collection method.

entity_types.name: Analytic product
entity_types.definition: A written analytic output (brief, memo, landscape) separating evidence, assumptions, and judgement.

entity_types.name: Professional role
entity_types.definition: A public, organization-level role (officer, director, listed holder of record) tied to a company. The only way a natural person appears in this domain; no profile, no sensitive attributes.
